title: Money must only be formatted through lib/invoices
body:
Amounts are integer cents. Pages and components must format them with `formatAmount` or `formatCurrency` from `lib/invoices.ts`, never inline (`amountCents / 100`, `.toFixed(2)`, a new `Intl.NumberFormat`). An inline format rounds differently and drifts from the CSV export. Nothing stops a change from doing it today; make that a check that fails.
